description: Defines the class FormatWithWorkStation which implements ValueFormatter to format subunit identifiers into their names within the OrangeHRM system, utilizing company structure services.

classes.name: FormatWithWorkStation
classes.description: A class that formats a subunit ID to its corresponding name using company structure services.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Returns the name of the subunit for a given ID if found, otherwise null.
